BUYER TOOLS

Compare before
you buy.

Version 0.1.0, free to use

The FABINT Price Finder is a free browser extension for Chrome and Edge. Open a product page anywhere, click the button, and see similar products from Fabrication Intelligence with prices to compare.

ON THIS PAGE

  1. Install it
  2. How it works
  3. What it reads
  4. Honest limits
  5. More buyer tools

Install it

Download the extension (zip)

  1. Unzip the file somewhere you will keep it.
  2. In Chrome or Edge, open the extensions page (chrome://extensions or edge://extensions) and turn on Developer mode.
  3. Choose Load unpacked and pick the unzipped folder. Pin the FABINT icon so it is one click away.

It is not in the Chrome Web Store or Edge Add-ons yet, which is why it installs this way. We plan to submit it once it has had real use.

How it works

When you click the button on a product page, the extension reads the product name and price shown on that page, then looks for similar products in our catalogue that you can buy now. It lists up to three, with our starting price, material and whether the finish and size are close. If the page shows an Australian dollar price and ours starts lower, it says so. You can also type what you want to find.

What it reads and what leaves your browser

  • It reads the page only when you click the button (the activeTab permission). It cannot see your other tabs or your browsing history.
  • The matching happens on your device. The page name, price and address are never sent to us or anyone else.
  • The only network request is to download our public product list from fabricationintelligence.com, which is saved on your device for one hour (the storage permission).
  • It has no accounts, no tracking and no adverts.

Honest limits

  • Matches are similar, not identical. Check size, finish, material and pack quantity before you buy.
  • We only show products we sell. If we do not stock something similar, it says so rather than guessing.
  • Our prices are starting prices that depend on size and finish, and we do not compare delivery costs.
  • It works best on pages that publish standard product data. When it cannot read a page, use the search box.
